• Wednesday, 15 October, 18.15 to 20.00: Open Access: external page Buzzword or Magic Formula? call_made Panel Discussion on the Swiss National Science Foundation's new publication funding. Organised by the UZH Graduate Campus in conjunction with the Zentralbibliothek Zürich.
• Wednesday 22 October, 13.00 to 20.00: How to go Open Access . ETH-Bibliothek webinar in English on the legal, financial and political parameters of open-access publishing.
The events are being held as part of the Open Access Week from 20 to 26 October. ETH-Bibliothek is also involved in the global campaign week again this year.
